questions.text: What happens if a student misses more than 20% of a course?
questions.hint: "Missing more than 20% of any course automatically results in a failing grade."

questions.text: Students at WKU may use AI tools to help write their essays.
questions.hint: "Students must not use AI tools to generate essays for submission."

questions.text: Which of these does the text say students DON'T have to do?
questions.hint: "They don't have to buy every book on the reading list immediately: the library has most of them."

questions.text: The text says students who don't follow recommendations find themselves in ___ trouble.
questions.hint: "students who don't often find themselves in avoidable trouble."

questions.text: The student support office exists for students who feel:
questions.hint: "The student support office exists precisely for moments of confusion or difficulty."

questions.text: According to the text, the best students follow every rule perfectly.
questions.hint: "students who do well... are the ones who understand which rules matter most, ask for help..."

questions.text: Why does Kamila have to choose between the two modules?
opts: Both are in the same time slot
questions.correct: Both are in the same time slot
questions.hint: "Both are in the same slot, so I have to choose."

questions.text: Professor Aidarov says she needn't do what before applying for the internship?
questions.hint: "No, you needn't have one at this stage."

questions.text: Professor Aidarov says the internship deadline is ___ and not extended.
questions.hint: "the deadline is strict and they don't extend it."

questions.text: The research methods workshop is compulsory for all students.
questions.hint: "Should I also take the optional research methods workshop? It's not compulsory."

questions.text: What GPA does Professor Aidarov say Kamila ought to have?
questions.hint: "you ought to have at least 3.5. Check the requirements carefully."

questions.text: Why does Professor Aidarov recommend the research methods workshop?
opts: It will help enormously with the dissertation
questions.correct: It will help enormously with the dissertation
questions.hint: "I strongly recommend it. It will help enormously with your dissertation."

questions.text: "You ___ plagiarise." (it is forbidden)
questions.hint: "mustn't" = PROHIBITED. "You MUSTN'T plagiarise." ✅

questions.text: "You ___ buy all the books." (it is not necessary)
questions.hint: "don't have to" = not necessary (optional). Books are in the library. ✅

questions.text: "She ___ (have to / notify) the department yesterday."
questions.hint: Past of "have to" = "had to". "She HAD TO notify the department." ✅

questions.text: "You ___ check your email daily." (advice)
questions.hint: "should" = advice/recommendation. "You SHOULD check your email." ✅

questions.text: "You ___ arrive early — the doors open at 9." (not necessary)
questions.hint: "needn't" = no necessity. "You NEEDN'T arrive early." ✅

questions.text: "Mustn't" and "don't have to" mean the same thing.
questions.hint: "mustn't" = prohibited. "don't have to" = not necessary. Completely different meanings!

questions.text: "She ___ submit it." (external deadline — external obligation)
questions.hint: External rule/deadline → "has to" (3rd person). "She HAS TO submit it." ✅

questions.text: "___ I bring a laptop?" (asking for advice)
questions.hint: "Should I...?" = asking for advice/recommendation. "SHOULD I bring a laptop?" ✅

questions.text: "Academic integrity" means:
opts: Honesty and doing your own work
questions.correct: Honesty and doing your own work
questions.hint: "integrity" = honesty and moral principles. "Academic integrity" = doing honest, original work.

questions.text: You must include a ___ whenever you use someone else's idea.
questions.hint: "citation" = a reference to the source you used — where you found the idea or quote.

questions.text: "Non-negotiable" means:
questions.hint: "non-negotiable" = cannot be negotiated, changed, or argued about. Absolute.

questions.text: "A second offence can mean suspension." "Suspension" means:
questions.hint: "suspension" = being temporarily stopped from attending university.

questions.text: "Students should provide documentation when absent." "Documentation" is:
questions.hint: "documentation" = official papers (like a doctor's certificate) that prove your reason for absence.
